Every task keeps a complete, immutable history, so your agent answers "what's the status?" without pinging humans. Connect via MCP in two minutes. EU-hosted, built for teams.

records.name: JSON Workbench
records.tagline: Privacy-first JSON & JWT tools that run in your browser
records.description: JSON Workbench started because I kept hitting the same wall: pasting real data (tokens, configs, payloads) into random online tools felt risky, and I never knew where that data actually went. So I built a set of dev tools, JSON formatter, JWT debugger, CSV to JSON converter, Excel compare, and more, that run fully in your browser. Nothing gets uploaded, nothing touches a server. If you handle sensitive JSON or JWTs at work and can't paste them into cloud tools or LLMs, this is built for you.

records.name: CitedByAI.lol
records.tagline: The leaderboard AI models read
records.description: A public, ranked dPay $5 to put your URL on a public board built for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot — clean HTML, JSON-LD, live llms.txt. irectory built for AI crawlers. Structured data, llms.txt, server-rendered listings. Bid to rank. Spots start at $5.

records.name: Quizera
records.tagline: Create and deploy a public assessment in seconds
records.description: Build and deploy AI-powered assessments in seconds. For candidate hiring, classroom educations, routine training, and general public testing. Unlimited assessments and testing. Participants don't need an account. Full support for rich-text formatting, code, equations, and images within questions.

records.name: Studiofront
records.tagline: A native macOS switcher for every Sanity Studio you manage
records.description: Do you manage many Sanity Studios across multiple organizations? I work at an agency and manage 20+ Sanity projects across several team organizations. Getting to the right Studio was always a pain, so I built a macOS menu bar app to fix it for myself. Open any Studio or document from anywhere, and navigate to it instantly. It also shows recently edited docs and live presence so I know what document's changed or who's currently in the Studio before I jump in.

records.name: Their First Words
records.tagline: First words and phrases for toddlers, in 8 languages
records.description: A calm, parent-led flashcard app for ages 0-5. 1,000+ illustrated words and 500+ everyday phrases, each spoken in 8 languages (English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Italian, Korean, Russian) by a female and a male native voice. Built for short sessions a parent and child do together: one card, one picture, one voice, nothing else on screen. Works offline, no account, no ads. 75 words and 35 phrases free forever; one 9.99 purchase unlocks the rest. No subscription.

records.name: SilkWallet
records.tagline: Shared expense & budget tracker for families & friends
records.description: Most budget apps are built for solo tracking or force you into roommate-style debt splitting. SilkWallet is designed for shared finances. It features multi-workspace support so you can keep personal spending private while managing joint household bills, groceries, and savings goals together with family and friends. Includes built-in financial calculators, one-tap Google Account sync, and a clean, clutter-free interface.

records.name: JustFlip! — Flashcards app
records.tagline: Focused flashcards for learning anything
records.description: JustFlip is a focused flashcard app for learning languages, science, programming, and anything else worth remembering. Create rich cards, review with spaced repetition, and keep your knowledge with you across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.

records.name: Love Future You
records.tagline: Write a letter to yourself. It arrives in exactly a year
records.description: Write a short letter, seal it, and forget it. One year later to the day, it lands back in your inbox in your own words, from a version of you that no longer exists. Write alone, or seal one with someone else and open each other's on the same day.

records.name: Formatex
records.tagline: Automate sportswear artwork from roster to print
records.description: Formatex automates repetitive pre-production work for sublimated sportswear. Import a roster, add player data and logos, generate personalized layouts, and move toward production-ready artwork in minutes instead of hours. Built for sportswear manufacturers that want faster turnaround, fewer manual errors, and more production capacity without adding repetitive design work.

records.name: Secret.pics
records.tagline: Turn any photo into a viral reveal game
records.description: Upload any photo, hide it behind numbered masks, and share one link. Players answer a quiz or complete a photo task to lift each mask, until the whole picture is revealed. The original never leaves the server a real reveal, not a blur. Free, no app, no account to play.

records.name: DropReady
records.tagline: Survive traffic spikes without your store crashing
records.description: DropReady is a virtual waiting room for stores that need to survive sudden traffic spikes - drops, launches, promotions. Without your server going down. Unlike Queue-it or Cloudflare Waiting Room, each client gets a dedicated, isolated instance - no shared multi-tenant infra, no CDN lock-in. Integration is a single PHP file (PrestaShop, WooCommerce, Magento, Laravel, anything PHP). Load-tested at 100% success, 500 req/s, ~123ms latency on a budget VPS.

records.name: TranslateMyCall 2.0
records.tagline: Free AI interpreter, just a phone call away. 47 languages.
records.description: TranslateMyCall is back — rebuilt from scratch on ThunderPhone's production voice-AI pipeline, now faster and more accurate than the 2024 original. Call (228) 888-8666 from any phone — no app, no account — and an AI interpreter joins the line. Merge it into a call so each side hears their own language, or put it on speakerphone for in-person interpreting. 47 languages officially supported; others may work as well! Free for a limited time.

records.name: Map Rank - Google Map Ranking Tracker
records.tagline: Google Maps Ranking Tracker for SEO Agencies
records.description: See exactly where your clients rank on Google Maps. Most google map ranking trackers come with bloated features that agencies don't need. Ours focuses on high quality rank tracking and white label functionality for agencies.

records.name: memeduck
records.tagline: Ad-free infinite meme scroller built for pure laughs
records.description: MemeDuck is a lightweight, ad-free infinite meme scroller built solo with React Native & Supabase. No cluttered feeds, no algorithm games, zero sponsored ads—just fast-loading, pure entertainment and a clean space to create and discover memes.

records.name: RoundOS
records.tagline: Free Docsend alternative
records.description: Stop paying for basic infrastructure. RoundOS Data Room: free, forever — the real alternative to DocSend, Papermark, and every other VDR. Share the deck, build the diligence room, gate it with watermarks and NDAs, and read the analytics behind every open. All of it, free.

records.name: onefit.ai – AI shoe sizing for Shopify
records.tagline: AI fit recommendations for Shopify shoe stores
records.description: onefit.ai is an AI shoe-sizing app for Shopify footwear retailers. Shoppers use their phone camera to capture their feet; AI turns that input into a personalised size recommendation on the product page. It helps customers choose with confidence, reduce fit-related returns, and improve conversion—without relying on a generic size chart.

records.name: Glowza: AI Hairstyle Try On
records.tagline: Find the perfect hairstyle for your face with AI
records.description: Glowza helps you discover hairstyles that actually suit your face. Upload a selfie, let AI analyze your facial features, and instantly preview different hairstyles on yourself before getting a haircut. Explore personalized hairstyle recommendations, compare realistic AI looks, and find the style that fits you best. No more guessing before your next haircut.

records.name: Agent X
records.tagline: Autonomous AI Agents & Workflow Automation Platform
records.description: Agent X is an AI automation console that unifies multi-model chat, autonomous agents, voice, vision, and team collaboration in one command center.

records.name: Humanize AI - ZX10R Mode
records.tagline: Bypass AI detectors in 1-click - 100% Human, Fast & Free
records.description: Tired of GPTZero & Turnitin flagging your content as AI? Humanize AI - ZX10R Mode rewrites any ChatGPT / Claude text into 100% natural, human-like writing that bypasses all AI detectors. ✅ Undetectable by GPTZero, Originality, Turnitin ✅ Keeps original meaning, no grammar mistakes ✅ ZX10R Mode - Lightning fast speed ✅ Free to use, no login needed Perfect for students, bloggers, marketers. Try ZX10R Mode now!

records.name: Aplup
records.tagline: Apps, Games, AI Tools & Developer Platform
records.description: Aplup is an all-in-one Android app marketplace. Use apps instantly without downloading, or download for offline access. Explore a wide range of AI tools, games, and apps, all in one secure platform. Create your own custom page with Creator Studio, publish articles, or shop for products. Aplup is designed to be fast, modern, and easy to use for everyone.

records.name: Customs Shield
records.tagline: AI customs compliance & expert marketplace for UK SMBs
records.description: Customs Shield combines 20+ AI-powered trade compliance tools with Clara, an AI customs advisor, and a marketplace of verified customs experts, all in one platform. Unlike generic compliance software, Customs Shield is built by a certified customs practitioner and purpose-made for individuals and UK SMBs navigating post-Brexit trade. Users can escalate to a real expert when they need certainty following usage of our AI tools.

records.name: Lineaum BrokerOS
records.tagline: Private jet broker software for air charter sales & sourcing
records.description: Lineaum’s AI-powered BrokerOS gives air charter brokers instant access to 30,000+ aircraft from 10,500+ operators worldwide, while automating quotations, invoices, contracts and payments, helping teams move from request to booking in minutes.

records.name: EnhanceCV
records.tagline: Free ATS Resume Builder & Resume Checker
records.description: Free, no-signup ATS resume builder, keyword checker, and cover-letter generator designed to pass ATS parsers like Workday, Greenhouse, and Lever without sounding generic.

records.name: Valued
records.tagline: Scan it. Know what it’s worth. Make it worth more.
records.description: Ever find something old and wonder if it’s actually worth anything? Valued turns your camera into an AI valuation expert. Scan antiques, collectibles, furniture, jewelry, and everyday items to identify what you have, estimate its resale value, and get practical advice on how to restore it and maximize what you can sell it for.

records.name: PDF Vault - Derivative But Smart LLC
records.tagline: Offline PDF scanner with AI redaction, 100% on-device
records.description: PDFVault turns your phone into a private document scanner. Capture crisp PDFs, then auto-redact sensitive info — SSNs, account numbers, emails — with fast on-device pattern detection, plus optional AI to catch context-specific data. It also names & sorts files and writes 3-bullet summaries, all offline. FaceID locks every doc. No account, no cloud, nothing leaves your device. Built for tax forms, medical records, contracts — anything you wouldn't upload to someone else's server.

records.name: ShareChef AI
records.tagline: Your personal chef. Any meal, anytime, from what you have.
records.description: Tell Micheli what is in your kitchen, even just two ingredients, and she creates a real dish around it. Then she cooks with you out loud, hands-free, waiting while you chop and adapting if you change something mid-cook. She remembers your allergies and dietary needs, speaks multiple languages, and helps you share what you made. Free on iPhone and web.

records.name: KnowledgeOS
records.tagline: Private AI that answers from your company's documents
records.description: KnowledgeOS runs 100% on your machine — documents never touch the cloud. Upload company docs (PDF, Word, Excel), ask questions in plain English, get instant answers WITH source citations. If it's not in your documents, it says "not found" — zero hallucination. 🔒 100% On-Premise, GDPR-friendly ⚡ Works fully offline 🎯 Honest AI with sources 👥 Team-ready with admin controls 7-day free trial.

records.name: Integro — you, against you
records.tagline: A wellness companion. No wearables. AI on curated science.
records.description: Integro is a morning ritual: a few questions, then one protocol for your day. No score to chase, no streak to break, no analytics. It measures you against your own past, not a population — and it tells you when it doesn't know enough to be specific.

records.name: PurePitch432
records.tagline: Real-time 432Hz tuning for Spotify & Apple Music
records.description: PurePitch432 shifts Spotify and Apple Music from 440Hz to 432Hz in real time, directly in your browser, with no quality loss. Many listeners describe 432Hz as warmer and more natural. No downloads, no re-encoding, no account needed to try. Free for Chrome and Firefox (Apple Music support is Chrome-only).

records.name: Whisper Web
records.tagline: Private speech-to-text that runs in your browser
records.description: Whisper Web turns audio, video and microphone recordings into editable text in your browser. The selected media is decoded and transcribed on your device—no account or media upload required. Choose Tiny, Base or Small Whisper models, use WebAssembly or WebGPU where supported, then export TXT, JSON, SRT or VTT. A separate workflow handles local files up to 1 GB or one hour.

records.name: AI Tool Rack
records.tagline: AI tools for business and personal use
records.description: Business & Marketing: AI tools for business management, digital marketing, SEO, social media, websites, sales, lead generation, and content writing. Education Research: AI tools to enhance the learning experience, automate citation management, and optimize research formatting. Industry Verticals: AI tools for real estate property analysis, legal document verification, healthcare compliance, and advanced document processing.

records.name: CarrelAI
records.tagline: A desk for your documents
records.description: Turn your documents into a workspace: read a PDF, ppt or Word file beside a board you can draw on and notes you can keep.

records.name: BriefGate
records.tagline: Your agent asks the client for assets. And chases them.
records.description: Claude Code builds the site in an afternoon, then waits two weeks for a logo. BriefGate lets the agent request client assets over MCP: the client gets a link (no account), uploads and fills in, and missing items are chased automatically. Free tier included.

records.name: CricBid
records.tagline: All-in-one platform for cricket tournaments
records.description: CricBid is an all-in-one platform built to simplify cricket tournament management. Organizers can manage player registrations with mobile OTP validation, create teams, conduct live-style cricket auctions, configure tournament rules, score matches, and manage the entire tournament from one place. From local box cricket tournaments to larger cricket events, CricBid brings registrations, team management, auctions, scoring, and tournament operations together in one platform.

records.name: Taobao Link Converter
records.tagline: Instantly convert Taobao Weidian & 1688 links to agent links
records.description: Tired of broken links when shopping from Chinese marketplaces? Taobao Link Converter is a free, lightning-fast online tool designed for global cross-border buyers. Simply paste any product link or shared text from Taobao, Weidian, or 1688, and instantly convert it into your preferred shopping agent link (Mulebuy, Hoobuy, Oopbuy, Superbuy, Sugargoo, and more). No registration or signup required—just clean, instant conversions with smart short-link resolution.

records.name: Zoomcut
records.tagline: Create cinematic Zoom effect in your Shorts videos
records.description: Upload a clip up to 7 minutes, And add manual zoom effects on a clean background, and download a 9:16 or 1:1 MP4 straight from your browser.

records.name: RealFiction-Love
records.tagline: Liebe ist kein Algorithmus
records.description: RealFiction Love verbindet Fiction DNA und Real DNA. Finde reale Menschen, die deinem Fiction Crush entsprechen – oder entdecke, ob du selbst jemandes fiktiver Typ bist.

records.name: Manner
records.tagline: AI clones of real developers that ship real software
records.description: Manner is a marketplace where developers create AI clones trained on their skills, memory, communication style, and engineering judgment. Clients hire those clones, connect a real app repo, and the clone works through an isolated coding agent that builds, runs, tests, and ships changes to a live preview. Developers stay in the loop when needed and earn from their clones' work.

records.name: PaisaLens
records.tagline: 100% private, on-device expense tracker for Android (India)
records.description: PaisaLens automatically captures your digital expenses from bank & UPI SMS using on-device, local AI—keeping your financial data 100% private and on your phone. Designed for total user control: don't want AI auto-capture? Turn it off anytime. Don't want to pay? Use manual expense entry for free forever. PaisaLens gives you an affordable, private, and flexible alternative to cloud-based expense trackers.
